source.note: TCDB base, rookie, related-set and parallel checklists, consulted 2026-10-07. The historical insertion table has no verified numeric odds for these Product Sets.

decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: One 420-card Base ProductSet combines Series One #1-170 and Donruss Update #171-420 with equal base-card availability. Each Gold and Silver Press Proof parallel remains a complete 420-card collector checklist.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Only the 28 numbered Base cards in TCDB's Rookie Cards index receive RC in Player. The other 85 cards bearing the ROO source annotation, Rated Rookies inserts, rookie-themed inserts and Press Proof parallels do not receive an unverified RC suffix.
decisions.checklistAndErrorHandling: Ten numbered base checklist cards have no team label by design. Player names omit ROO, CL, UER and other source annotations. Base and Press Proof #154/#231 retain the documented UER details in Variant. The Press Proof #29 subject follows its source as Javier Lopez, whereas Base #29 is Javy Lopez.
decisions.crusadeReconciliation: TCDB says 70 Donruss-issued cards per Crusade color: #1-40 and #71-100. Purple #11 Mike Mussina, #30 Todd Walker and #91 Jason Kendall also appear erroneously in the Donruss checklist although the Leaf checklist assigns them to 1998 Leaf; excluded from this Product. Call to Arms cards lack printed numbers but retain catalog numbers in VCS and a Variant note.
decisions.signaturePreview: The 34-card unnumbered autograph checklist uses deterministic NNO-01 through NNO-34 keys in source order. Alou, Casey, Jenkins, Jeter and Wilson were secondary-market releases after Pinnacle's bankruptcy; those five are identified in Variant and do not have separate pack odds.
decisions.productChannelDifferences: Production Line OBP was jumbo only, Power Index hobby only and Slugging Percentage retail only. Historical channel distinctions are documented in ProductSet notes; the combined virtual pack has no channel selector.
decisions.packFormat: Four-card VCS pack, 24 packs per virtual box. Physical hobby and retail packs had ten cards; 24 packs per box. Two physical series are combined into one virtual pack.
decisions.unknownOdds: Neither TCDB nor the referenced historical insertion table supplies reliable numeric pack odds for these insert and parallel checklists. ProductSet oddsPerPack remains null throughout. Cards are cataloged but excluded from virtual hit pulls until odds are reviewed and configured; no print-run-to-pack-odds estimates were invented.
decisions.excludedPromos: Executive Crusade promos, dealer samples, sweepstakes forms, production-line promos and Leaf-issued Crusades are not modeled as pack-issued Donruss cards.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product is unreleased pending pack art, card images, pricing and deliberate virtual insertion odds.

productSets.name: Base
